headlines.title: 央行陆磊：中国没有必要也无意通过汇率贬值来获取贸易竞争优势
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，中国实施有管理的浮动汇率制度，坚持市场在汇率形成中的决定作用，防范市场羊群效应和非理性预期的自我强化，中国没有必要也无意通过汇率贬值来获取贸易竞争优势。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei: China has no need and no intention to gain trade competitive advantage through currency depreciation
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei said that China implements a managed floating exchange rate regime, adheres to the decisive role of the market in exchange rate formation, and guards against market herd behavior and the self-reinforcement of irrational expectations. China has no need and no intention to gain trade competitive advantage through currency depreciation.

headlines.title: 央行陆磊：央行将完善存款准备金制度，更加灵活精准开展公开市场操作
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，“十五五”时期，人民银行将持续健全基础货币投放机制，完善存款准备金制度，更加灵活精准开展公开市场操作，不断健全市场化利率形成、调控和传导机制，增强政策利率引导作用，引导短端货币市场利率围绕政策利率更加平稳运行。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei: The PBOC will improve the reserve requirement system and conduct open market operations with greater flexibility and precision
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei said that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the PBOC will continue to improve the base money supply mechanism, refine the deposit reserve system, conduct open market operations in a more flexible and precise manner, continuously improve the market-based interest rate formation, regulation and transmission mechanism, enhance the guiding role of the policy interest rate, and guide short-term money market rates to operate more smoothly around the policy interest rate.

headlines.title: 央行陆磊：央行将坚定保持货币币值稳定 同时逐步淡化数量型中介目标
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，“十五五”时期，人民银行将进一步完善优化中国特色现代货币政策框架体系。人民银行将坚定保持货币币值稳定，并以此促进经济增长，有效支持实体经济高质量发展。同时，逐步淡化数量型中介目标，更加注重发挥利率型调控工具的作用。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei: The PBOC will firmly maintain currency stability while gradually downplaying quantity-based intermediate targets
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei said that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the PBOC will further improve and optimize the modern monetary policy framework with Chinese characteristics. The PBOC will firmly maintain the stability of the currency's value and thereby promote economic growth, effectively supporting the high-quality development of the real economy. At the same time, it will gradually淡化 quantitative intermediary targets and place greater emphasis on the role of interest rate-based regulatory tools.

headlines.title: 央行陆磊：央行将常态化发行国债和中央银行票据，丰富高等级人民币资产池
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，“十五五”时期，人民银行将继续支持离岸人民币市场健康发展，优化人民币清算行布局，健全多层次跨期限的流动性供给机制，保持离岸市场人民币流动性充足稳定，常态化发行国债和中央银行票据，丰富高等级人民币资产池。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei: The PBOC will regularly issue government bonds and central bank bills to enrich the pool of high-grade RMB assets
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei said that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the PBOC will continue to support the healthy development of the offshore RMB market, optimize the layout of RMB clearing banks, improve the multi-tiered cross-tenor liquidity supply mechanism, keep offshore market RMB liquidity ample and stable, normalize the issuance of government bonds and central bank bills, and enrich the pool of high-grade RMB assets.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：大力引导上市公司增强投资者回报的持续性
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，证监会将持续发挥资本市场的并购重组主渠道作用，着力构建活而有序的并购市场生态。大力督促引导上市公司强化投资者回报意识，增强投资者回报的持续性、及时性和可预期性，更好维护广大中小投资者合法权益。

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Vigorously guide listed companies to enhance the sustainability of investor returns
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said that the CSRC will continue to give full play to the capital market's role as the main channel for M&A and restructuring, and strive to build a dynamic yet orderly M&A market ecosystem. It will vigorously urge and guide listed companies to strengthen their awareness of investor returns, enhance the continuity, timeliness and predictability of investor returns, and better safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the broad masses of small and medium-sized investors.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：促进人工智能在资本市场规范应用
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，下一步证监会将着力提高资本市场监管和治理水平，不断完善准入、持续监管、退市和交易、机构等全链条监管体系，加快构建行政刑事民事有效衔接的追责体系。促进人工智能在资本市场规范应用，推进监管数智化转型，加强新型业务监管和风险管控。

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Promote the standardized application of artificial intelligence in the capital market
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said that next the CSRC will focus on improving the level of capital market regulation and governance, continuously refine the full-chain regulatory system covering access, ongoing supervision, delisting, trading and institutions, and accelerate the building of an accountability system that effectively links administrative, criminal and civil liability. It will promote the standardized application of artificial intelligence in the capital market, advance the digital and intelligent transformation of regulation, and strengthen supervision and risk control of new types of business.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：推动中长期资金稳步提升入市规模和比例
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，下一步，证监会将持续健全“长钱长投”的市场机制和生态，推动中长期资金稳步提升入市规模和比例，大力发展权益类公募基金，强化各类中长期资金“稳定器”功能。强化跨市场跨行业跨境风险监测，推动健全支持资本市场货币政策工具长效机制，丰富政策工具箱。加强和改进资本市场预期管理，积极营造良好舆论生态。

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Promote the steady increase in the scale and proportion of medium- and long-term funds entering the market
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said that next the CSRC will continue to improve the market mechanism and ecosystem for "long-term money and long-term investment," promote a steady increase in the scale and proportion of medium- and long-term funds entering the market, vigorously develop equity public funds, and strengthen the "stabilizer" function of various types of medium- and long-term funds. It will strengthen cross-market, cross-industry and cross-border risk monitoring, promote the improvement of a long-term mechanism for monetary policy tools supporting the capital market, and enrich the policy toolbox. It will strengthen and improve capital market expectation management and actively foster a sound public opinion environment.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：持续加强稳市场机制建设 全力维护资本市场平稳运行
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，进一步增强资本市场内在稳定性。总结过去几年经验做法，持续加强稳市场机制建设，不断壮大市场稳定力量。进一步拓宽中长期资金来源、渠道和入市方式，健全“长钱长投”的市场机制和生态。强化风险监测预警和综合研判应对，全力维护资本市场平稳运行。

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Continuously strengthen the market stabilization mechanism and make every effort to maintain the smooth operation of the capital market
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said that the intrinsic stability of the capital market will be further enhanced. Summarizing the experience and practices of the past few years, China will continue to strengthen the building of market stabilization mechanisms and steadily expand the forces for market stability. It will further broaden the sources, channels and market entry methods for medium- and long-term funds, and improve the market mechanism and ecosystem for "long-term money and long-term investment." It will strengthen risk monitoring, early warning and comprehensive analysis and response, and make every effort to maintain the smooth operation of the capital market.

headlines.title: 证监会明确“十五五”资本市场发展目标，加快推进实施新一轮资本市场改革开放
headlines.summary: 中国证监会副主席李超9月10日在国新办举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上说，加快推进实施新一轮资本市场改革开放，力争到2030年资本市场建立四十周年之际，基本形成资本市场高质量发展新格局，综合实力与国际竞争力明显提高。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: CSRC clarifies capital market development goals for the 15th Five-Year Plan, accelerates implementation of a new round of capital market reform and opening up
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said on September 10 at the State Council Information Office's series of thematic press conferences on "Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan" that China will accelerate the implementation of a new round of capital market reform and opening up, and strive to basically form a new pattern of high-quality capital market development by 2030, the 40th anniversary of the establishment of the capital market, with comprehensive strength and international competitiveness notably improved. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 境外主体持有境内人民币金融资产超11万亿元
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行副行长陆磊9月10日在国新办举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上介绍，目前，境外主体持有境内人民币金融资产超11万亿元，80多个国家和地区的央行或货币当局将人民币纳入外汇储备；熊猫债发行超1.3万亿元，发行主体覆盖五大洲26个国家和地区。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Overseas entities hold over 11 trillion yuan in onshore RMB financial assets
headlines.summary_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei introduced on September 10 at the State Council Information Office's series of thematic press conferences on "Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan" that currently overseas entities hold more than RMB 11 trillion in onshore RMB financial assets, and central banks or monetary authorities in more than 80 countries and regions have included the RMB in their foreign exchange reserves; panda bond issuance has exceeded RMB 1.3 trillion, with issuers covering 26 countries and regions across five continents. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 证监会副主席李超：今年以来沪深两市IPO平均审核周期缩短至6个多月
headlines.summary: 在国新办举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上，中国证监会副主席李超表示，证监会将更大力度激发市场活力。支持新质生产力优质企业发展壮大，是新征程上资本市场的时代使命。近年来，证监会推出深化科创板、创业板等改革，进一步提升再融资灵活性便利性，改革成效逐步显现。今年以来，沪深两市IPO平均审核周期缩短至6个多月，一些优质公司再融资审核不到1个月。（21财经）

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Since the start of this year, the average IPO review period for the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges has shortened to more than 6 months
headlines.summary_en: At the State Council Information Office's series of thematic press conferences on "Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan," CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said that the CSRC will make greater efforts to stimulate market vitality. Supporting the growth and expansion of high-quality enterprises in new quality productive forces is the era mission of the capital market on the new journey. In recent years, the CSRC has launched reforms to deepen the STAR Market and ChiNext, further enhancing the flexibility and convenience of refinancing, and the reform results have gradually emerged. Since the beginning of this year, the average IPO review period for the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets has shortened to more than 6 months, and some high-quality companies have had refinancing reviews completed in less than 1 month. (21st Century Business Herald)

headlines.title: 证监会李超：“十五五”资本市场重点做好八个“进一步”
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，“十五五”资本市场重点要做好八个方面工作，一是进一步提高资本市场制度包容性、适应性；二是进一步增强资本市场内在稳定性；三是进一步加强监管和投资者保护；四是进一步健全多层次资本市场体系；五是进一步提高上市公司质量和投资价值；六是进一步加快建设一流投资银行和投资机构；七是进一步建设安全高效的金融基础设施；八是进一步扩大高水平对外开放。

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: The 15th Five-Year Plan period will focus on eight 'further' priorities for the capital market
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the capital market will focus on doing well in eight areas: first, further improving the inclusiveness and adaptability of the capital market system; second, further enhancing the intrinsic stability of the capital market; third, further strengthening regulation and investor protection; fourth, further improving the multi-tiered capital market system; fifth, further improving the quality and investment value of listed companies; sixth, further accelerating the building of first-class investment banks and investment institutions; seventh, further building safe and efficient financial infrastructure; and eighth, further expanding high-level opening up.

headlines.title: 证监会副主席李超：修订后的证券公司监管条例有望于近期出台
headlines.summary: 证监会副主席李超10日下午在国新办新闻发布会上表示，更大力度加强法治保障。我们将坚持在市场化、法治化轨道上推进改革发展，发挥好法治固根本、稳预期、利长远的重要作用，进一步健全资本市场法律制度体系。修订后的证券公司监管条例有望于近期出台。我们还将抓紧推动证券投资基金法、上市公司监管条例等重要法律法规的制定修改。同时，进一步完善符合我国国情市情的投资者保护体系，积极营造公开公正的市场环境。

headlines.summary_zh: 证监会副主席李超10日下午在国新办新闻发布会上表示，更大力度加强法治保障。我们将坚持在市场化、法治化轨道上推进改革发展，发挥好法治固根本、稳预期、利长远的重要作用，进一步健全资本市场法律制度体系。修订后的证券公司监管条例有望于近期出台。我们还将抓紧推动证券投资基金法、上市公司监管条例等重要法律法规的制定修改。同时，进一步完善符合我国国情市情的投资者保护体系，积极营造公开公正的市场环境。
headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: The revised regulations on securities company supervision are expected to be issued in the near future
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said on the afternoon of September 10 at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office that legal safeguards will be strengthened with greater efforts. We will adhere to promoting reform and development on the track of marketization and rule of law, give full play to the important role of the rule of law in consolidating foundations, stabilizing expectations and benefiting the long term, and further improve the capital market legal system. The revised Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Securities Companies are expected to be issued in the near future. We will also promptly push forward the formulation and amendment of important laws and regulations such as the Securities Investment Fund Law and the Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Listed Companies. At the same time, we will further improve the investor protection system suited to China's national conditions and market conditions, and actively foster an open and fair market environment.

headlines.title: 央行陆磊：“十五五”时期将完善金融统计、支付、国库、现金服务体系
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，“十五五”时期，人民银行将全面夯实央行履职基础，持续优化金融基础设施和中央银行服务体系，提升中央银行金融服务质效，完善金融统计、支付、国库、现金服务体系。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the financial statistics, payment, treasury, and cash service systems will be improved
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei said that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the PBOC will comprehensively consolidate the foundation for the performance of central bank duties, continuously optimize financial infrastructure and the central bank service system, improve the quality and efficiency of central bank financial services, and refine the financial statistics, payment, treasury and cash service systems.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth accelerated in August, while consumer inflation picked up again, amid volatile energy and commodity costs linked to the US-Israel war on Iran.
The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.
The reading beat a 3.6 per cent projection from economists polled by financial data provider Wind.

headlines.title_zh: 中国8月工业品出厂价格涨幅回升，伊朗战争加剧能源波动
headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月份工厂出厂价格增速加快，而消费者通胀再次抬头，原因在于与美以对伊朗战争相关的能源和大宗商品成本波动。国家统计局周三发布的数据显示，上月生产者价格指数同比上涨3.8%，高于7月份的3.5%。

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: The capital market is undergoing increasingly profound structural changes
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said that in recent years, the CSRC has implemented the tasks set out in the new "State Council Nine-Point Guidelines," taken the reform of the STAR Market and ChiNext as a breakthrough, further enhanced the inclusiveness and adaptability of the system, vigorously promoted the entry of medium- and long-term funds into the market, and continuously deepened the comprehensive reform of capital market investment and financing. The capital market is undergoing increasingly profound structural changes, the trend of coordinated development of investment and financing is accelerating, and the quality and efficiency of serving the real economy are steadily improving.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：提高监管执法威慑力 完善投资者保护制度机制
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，进一步加强监管和投资者保护。坚守金融工作的人民性，持续强化“五大监管”，聚焦欺诈发行、财务造假、操纵市场、内幕交易等重大违法行为，在“打准、打疼”上下功夫，提高监管执法威慑力。加快推动健全资本市场法律制度体系，完善投资者保护制度机制，让投资者切实感受到市场的公平正义。

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Enhance the deterrent power of regulatory enforcement and improve investor protection systems and mechanisms
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said that supervision and investor protection will be further strengthened. Upholding the people-centered nature of financial work, continuously strengthening the "five major areas of supervision," focusing on major illegal acts such as fraudulent issuance, financial fraud, market manipulation, and insider trading, and working hard to "target accurately and hit hard" to increase the deterrent power of regulatory enforcement. Accelerate the improvement of the legal and institutional system of the capital market, improve investor protection institutions and mechanisms, and let investors truly feel the fairness and justice of the market.

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Optimize the issuance and listing system to support the growth and expansion of high-quality enterprises in emerging industries
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said that the inclusiveness and adaptability of the capital market system will be further improved. China will proactively adapt to the new trends of global scientific and technological innovation and industrial transformation, continue to intensify efforts in the "five major articles" including sci-tech finance, and vigorously improve the quality and efficiency of the capital market in serving the development of new quality productive forces. It will optimize the issuance and listing system and support the growth and expansion of diversified high-quality enterprises of different types and industries, including emerging industries, future industries, the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, modern services and new types of consumption.

headlines.title: 中长期资金持有A股流通市值较去年底增长12.5%
headlines.summary: 中国证监会副主席李超9月10日在国新办举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上说，今年以来，社保、年金、保险等中长期资金合计净买入A股超6000亿元，持有A股流通市值较2025年底增长12.5%。(新华社)

headlines.title_en: Medium- and long-term funds' holdings of A-share tradable market value increased by 12.5% from the end of last year
headlines.summary_en: Li Chao, Vice Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, said on September 10 at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office as part of the "Starting the 15th Five-Year Plan" series that since the beginning of this year, medium- and long-term funds such as social security funds, annuities, and insurance have made net purchases of A-shares totaling more than 600 billion yuan, and the market value of their holdings of tradable A-shares increased by 12.5% compared with the end of 2025. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title_en: PBOC's Lu Lei: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, CIPS functions and services will be optimized
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC's Lu Lei: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, CIPS functions and services will be optimized] At a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, People's Bank of China Deputy Governor Lu Lei said that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the PBOC will continue to improve the construction of the RMB cross-border payment system, optimize the functions and services of the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS), advance the interconnection of fast payment systems, QR code payments, and other systems, and actively promote the use of the digital yuan in cross-border scenarios.
